request.request: Write the paragraph from the officer's details in document 1.

response_text: {"paragraph":"I'm writing on behalf of Trojan Robotics, a student club at USC, about our Spring Build Day. On the day, students build small robots in teams, and senior members of the club teach soldering. The event is for students who want to learn by building something with their own hands. Your help would matter because hands-on learning depends on having enough materials within reach. Spare parts and soldering kits would let every team keep building and let students practice soldering with guidance from our senior members, rather than waiting for a turn or watching from the side. We would be glad to tell you more about the day.","contains_instructions":false}
